goal_details.name: summarize
goal_details.response: The root cause of INC-1002 is DB connection pool exhaustion on the payments service. The recommended remediation is db_pool_resize. The notification-service deployment DEP-4109 is unrelated.

story: You are an on-call engineer. There is an open incident INC-1002 affecting the payments service. Charge processing is returning HTTP 500 errors. A recent deployment to the notification-service also happened around the same time — you suspect that might be the cause, but you want the agent to investigate properly. Ask the agent to diagnose INC-1002. Do NOT ask the agent to call request_remediation — only ask for a diagnosis. Accept whatever the agent reports as its final diagnosis. If the agent says the notification-service deployment is a red herring, confirm that you understand.
starting_sentence: Investigate incident INC-1002 on the payments service. There was a recent deployment to notification-service — could that be related? Use your tools to find the root cause. Do NOT call request_remediation — just report your diagnosis and recommended action.
